lines.cap: You're a king, and everyone wants your throne. So, you build a castle.
lines.say: You're a king, and everyone wants your throne. So, you build a castle.

lines.cap: First, a wooden tower on a hill. Cheap, fast, and very easy to burn.
lines.say: First, a wooden tower on a hill. Cheap, fast, and very easy to burn.

lines.cap: So you switch to stone. A huge square keep. Fire can't touch it.
lines.say: So you switch to stone. A huge square keep. Fire can't touch it.

lines.cap: But your enemies dig under one corner, burn the supports, and the whole corner falls. King John did exactly that, in 1215.
lines.say: But your enemies dig under one corner, burn the supports, and the whole corner falls. King John did exactly that, in 1215.

lines.cap: So, being a genius, you make every tower round. No corners to bring down.
lines.say: So, being a genius, you make every tower round. No corners to bring down.

lines.cap: You wrap it all in a high wall, packed with archers.
lines.say: You wrap it all in a high wall, packed with archers.

lines.cap: Still not enough? You add a second, lower wall in front. Now anyone who breaks through is trapped between two walls, with arrows coming from both.
lines.say: Still not enough? You add a second, lower wall in front. Now anyone who breaks through is trapped between two walls, with arrows coming from both.

lines.cap: Then a moat, and a gate with holes in the ceiling, for dropping rocks on anyone inside.
lines.say: Then a moat, and a gate with holes in the ceiling, for dropping rocks on anyone inside.

lines.cap: The Crusaders built a castle just like this. Krak des Chevaliers. In 1271, it fell anyway.
lines.say: The Crusaders built a castle just like this. Krak des Chevaliers. In 1271, it fell anyway.

lines.cap: To a fake letter, ordering them to surrender.
lines.say: To a fake letter, ordering them to surrender.

lines.cap: The weakest part of any castle is the people inside it.
lines.say: The weakest part of any castle is the people inside it.
